reason: Arithmetic lens: the measurement itself is feasible, but the claimed +0.001..+0.003 private gain does not survive a recount of which decisions are still open. (1) What the judge can resolve (checked on edges_exp39.parquet): true GT steps have q99 4.57 um and q99.9 5.77 um, so the 6 um tracklet cut removes about 0.06% of true edges. The ef edge set (59,408 unscored relink edges where the ILP linked elsewhere) has a median length of 2.18 um (q90 3.8), so the cut does not hide them. Real 44b6 GT gives only 20,085 evaluable edges over 71 videos, and just 348 of them are ef edges (299 FP), yet 44b6 confirmation showed +0.0145. A 10% unseen-cell pseudo-GT would make about 10x more edges evaluable, so the ef calibration (drop break-even precision ~J/(1+J) = 0.47) is resolvable. That part stands. (2) The decision pool is mostly gone or out of reach. Stitch's +0.0021 was measured ON TOP OF the edge filter, and CONTEXT (24 Sep 16:55) closed the stitch bundle together with it. Float coords get an LB probe on 25 Sep and only a sign-only verdict here. Fork-midpoint (+0.0007) acts on the 0.1 x division term, and the pseudo-GT has no forks, so it is unjudgeable. Probe 31 measures coordhead's total effect directly, and the multiplier split needs position accuracy below the pseudo-GT's median 1.29 um noise. What is left: frozen ILP-first (+0.0013 in-sample, ILP-trusting), stitch re-measured on exp48 (~+0.002 in-sample at best, ILP-trusting) and overlap consensus (0-0.004, only if the private embryos have overlapping crops). (3) Transfer prior: measured LB/lab ratios for ILP-trusting gains are 0/0.0162, -0.001/0.0095 and -0.002/0.0053, a mean of about -0.1. So the prior true OOS gain of the ILP-trusting candidates is about 0 +- 0.001. Take judge sd ~0.0006 (the research's +-0.001 90% CI with 11 leak groups) and ship at >= +0.001. Then the expected value per item is E[g*1(ghat>c)] = sg^2/s * phi(c/s) = (1e-6/0.00117)*0.277 = about +0.00024. Two items give ~+0.0005; overlap consensus adds perhaps +0.0005 if its prior is positive. Realistic total: +0.0003..+0.001 private, 0 public, against a 0.022 gap to 0.97 (under 5%). The 'avoided loss' part is already captured for free by the post-probe-29/30 policy of not shipping ILP-trusting lab gains without an LB test, so it cannot be counted again. (4) The calibration target is weak. Criterion B checks the judge against two LB points, each noisy by +-0.002-0.003, and accepts a residual optimism of up to +0.004 on ef_a3. That tolerance is 2-3x the size of the items the judge would then gate (0.0013-0.002). The LB cannot validate a judge below its own resolution. (5) The resolution claim is overstated. The '+-0.0005 from 117k edges' ignores that 63 clips form only 11 independent leak groups, and that Stage-1 boxes are 24 correlated boxes from one late slab (t >= 380). Research already widened it to +-0.001-0.0015. At that width the stitch/frozen-sized deltas (0.0013-0.002) sit at 1-2 sigma. Stage 1 (40 GB of streaming, 1.5-3 h, plus a GPU run and a day of glue code) costs more than the <= +0.001 it could protect with 5 days left, and pulls effort from node-position work, whose FN oracle is +0.03-0.046.
fix_if_any: Keep only Stage 0 and cut the claim to 'decision support, ~+0.0005 expected'. Build pseudo_gt_dorado.py with a half-day cap and score it on the existing 63 44b6 caches with Kaggle CPU replay. Drop Stage 1 entirely: streaming cost and late-stage shift for a <= +0.001 decision value. Make it earn its keep by pointing it at the node-position / duplicate-suppression items (near-duplicate track merge, coordhead retrain on 199), not at the closed stitch/ef line. Those items change node counts and matching topology, which a 10% unseen-cell pseudo-GT can judge with ~10x the evaluable edges of real 44b6 GT, and they are where the remaining +0.03 oracle lies. Replace criterion B with a proportional check: on the unseen arm, ef_a3 must retain <= 25% of its seen-arm delta, i.e. <= +0.004 on a +0.016 in-sample gain. Then gate items at >= +0.001 with a leak-group-bootstrap CI > 0 and >= 7/11 groups positive. Keep the seen-arm validity check A, since the ef calibration is resolvable: 348 real-GT evaluable ef edges on 44b6 against thousands on pseudo-GT. Report the division term as unjudged, and coordinate items as sign-only.
realistic_public_gain: 0 directly (methodology only). On private, about +0.0003..+0.001 expected from gating 2-3 remaining ILP-trusting or overlap items (EV ~+0.00024 per item under a ~0 +- 0.001 true-gain prior), not the claimed +0.001..+0.003. It contributes nothing toward the 0.022 gap to the 0.97 target unless it is re-aimed at node-position items.
